rows.heading: ### Band A — provider-side megaleverage (where the real 10x lives)
rows.evidence_or_reason: Scope retained/reorganized with current primary contracts, explicit uncertainty and fixed-model/effort gates; unsupported workload, quota and composition multipliers withdrawn.

rows.heading: ### K1. Soft-prompt context compression: gist tokens, ICAE, AutoCompressors, Activation Beacon, 500xCompressor
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain all five learned-compression families with exact paper versions, model/activation requirements and task-transfer limits; retire hosted-day arithmetic.
rows.current_heading: K1. Gist, ICAE, AutoCompressors, Activation Beacon and 500xCompressor

rows.heading: ### K2. KV-cache as a persistent, shippable artifact (LMCache + CacheGen)
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain persistent KV infrastructure, current LMCache architecture and CacheGen; replace storage-only pricing with deployment/restore/isolation economics.
rows.current_heading: K2. KV state as a persistent artifact

rows.heading: ### K3. Server-side context editing + memory offload (Anthropic context management)
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain native context editing and memory; separate historical vendor evaluations, signed continuation and full iteration/cache accounting.
rows.current_heading: K3. Provider context editing plus external memory

rows.heading: ### K4. Context distillation into fine-tunes of repeated instructions
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain distillation; verify scoped public customization availability, remove universal economic impossibility and keep changed weights outside the fixed-model arm.
rows.current_heading: K4. Distill standing context into a fine-tuned model

rows.heading: ### K5. Provider cache-price arbitrage (DeepSeek-class economics at a gateway)
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain cache-price routing as a separate explicit provider/model policy; retire old price ratio and unmeasured workload allocation.

rows.heading: ### Band B — session-layer frontier (deployable, small, real)
rows.evidence_or_reason: Scope retained/reorganized with current primary contracts, explicit uncertainty and fixed-model/effort gates; unsupported workload, quota and composition multipliers withdrawn.

rows.heading: ### K6. In-context session codebooks (negotiated abbreviation tables)
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain codebooks as a versioned exact-reference experiment; retire unreproduced token counts and daily output-share forecast.

rows.heading: ### K7. Single-token semantic anchors
rows.evidence_or_reason: Correct universal tokenizer floor/physics claim; retain aliases with complete-envelope counting, shared dictionary and referent tests.

rows.heading: ### K8. Self-extending abbreviation registries in memory files
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain persistent registry; add consumer/epoch/version lifetime and dangling-alias protection; retire fixed reuse threshold.

rows.heading: ### K9. Prompt-as-program / run-length encoding of repeated structure
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain templates and deterministic expansion; require exact expansion/grammar cost; retire token-only daily forecast.

rows.heading: ### K10. Token-aligned identifier naming (tokenizer-aware code style)
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain token-aware naming as measurement advisory; preserve readable language/API contracts and reject speculative bulk-renaming benefit.

rows.heading: ### K11. Tokenizer arbitrage routing (the under-reported 1.35x on top of the 10x)
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain tokenizer/model routing separately from fixed-model compression; replace old ratios/default Haiku assumption with actual current treatment accounting.

rows.heading: ### K12. Thinking-channel compression: effort routing now, Chain-of-Draft as the ceiling
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain terse reasoning/effort questions; separate visible style, provider effort and output limits; retire inferred hidden-reasoning shares and savings ceiling.
rows.current_heading: K12. Shorter reasoning and effort controls

rows.heading: ### K13. Cache-keepalive daemon (rewritten by the 1h-TTL discovery)
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain paid warming conditional on reuse/TTL/billing route; withdraw hidden resume ping default, universal one-hour TTL and 19-hour/46-minute rules.
rows.current_heading: K13. Paid cache warming and renewal

rows.heading: ### Band C — infrastructure: where the discipline gets baked in
rows.evidence_or_reason: Scope retained/reorganized with current primary contracts, explicit uncertainty and fixed-model/effort gates; unsupported workload, quota and composition multipliers withdrawn.

rows.heading: ### K14. Compression-hygiene CI linter (token budget for always-loaded files)
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain context CI inventory/regression guard; preserve requirements, count actual host loading, label proxies and retire arbitrary universal budgets/dollar drift.

rows.heading: ### K15. Hard-prompt compression at the append seam (LLMLingua-2 gateway)
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain learned ingestion pruning; correct LLMLingua-2 token-classifier mechanism, require real host seam, rare-fact fidelity, runtime/recovery and task evidence.
rows.current_heading: K15. Learned text pruning at ingestion

rows.heading: ### K16. The jackin❯-baked optimization pack (orchestrator as delivery vehicle)
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain orchestrator policy delivery as proposed versioned integration; preserve selected model/effort/native authority and remove summed pack forecast.

rows.heading: ### V1. Quota-window scheduler — shape work to the cap's reset clock
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain quota scheduling using actual authorized observations and deadlines; withdraw universal five-hour windows, read weights and model-band allocation forecasts.

rows.heading: ### V2. Per-account quota-denominator prober — fit the cap weight from your own headers
rows.evidence_or_reason: Reframe denominator probing as supported quota observation/calibration; expose identifiability, delayed snapshots, drift and unknown coefficients.
rows.current_heading: V2. Per-account quota observation and calibration

rows.heading: ### V3. Vision-tier auto-router — every screenshot to the cheap tokenizer family
rows.evidence_or_reason: Separate same-model media representation from explicit vision-model routing; withdraw cap-to-task/quality/quota transfer and require original/spatial fidelity.
rows.current_heading: V3. Vision representation and optional vision-model routing

rows.heading: ### V4. Screenshot/PDF → text transcoder at ingestion — pay text, not the media tax
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain text/OCR extraction with original/page provenance; remove universal exactness, quality improvement and unreproduced savings ranges.

rows.heading: ### V5. Time-value auto fast-mode — flip fast mode by who is waiting
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain explicit same-model speed profile; include whole critical path, autonomous deadlines, actual billing and current persistent cache-header behavior.

rows.heading: ### V6. Hosted "warm repo" — the CAG pattern as a fleet-shared, always-warm cached prefix
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain revisioned cached core and stagger hypothesis; preserve provider/tenant/workspace scope, native staggering and actual receipts; retire tenfold/fullfleet forecast.
rows.current_heading: V6. Cached repository core and staggered starts

rows.heading: ### V7. Online-canary-gated adaptive compression — compress hard only while a live judge says it's safe
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain monitoring/rollback for prequalified lanes; sampled async judges cannot establish safety or prevent prior failures; include calibration and full guard cost.
rows.current_heading: V7. Online monitoring with bounded rollback

rows.heading: ### V8. Cross-provider portable token-policy compiler — one policy, every agent's config
rows.evidence_or_reason: Retain capability-aware compiler proposal; require native activation and off-path conformance; remove neutral translation and60/80-percent portability claims.
